title: R Praggnanandhaa Wins 2026 Norway Chess Title Defeating Magnus Carlsen Twice
summary: Becomes 1st Indian champion of Norway Chess since tournament inception in 2013.

blocks.content: Becomes 1st Indian champion of Norway Chess since tournament inception in 2013.

items: Title Victory: Indian GM R Praggnanandhaa won 2026 Norway Chess title by defeating Vincent Keymer in the final.
Carlsen Defeats: Defeated 7-time champion and World No. 1 Magnus Carlsen twice in classical chess.
